Game Overview

Save the Brainrot puts players into a puzzle experience centered on safeguard the lovable Brainrot from Bombardino Crocodilo's relentless assault in this thrilling puzzle adventure. Hone your wits to draw protective barriers, creating clever defenses in a race against time. Outsmart the threat and experience heart-pounding excitement as you strategize each move in this captivating draw-to-save challenge.
